title: Log Models
description: Log models for capturing and streaming application log entries.

LogEntry.description: A single log entry from the application.

t.description: UTC timestamp when the log entry was recorded.

l.description: Severity string supplied by the producer. ILogger uses Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, and Critical; WebView console levels may use other casing or names.

e.description: Exception details if the log entry is associated with an error.

s.description: Producer-defined source, for example native, webview, console, console.error, or trace. May be null.
